newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - Telstra, IBM sign internet security pact.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - Telstra, IBM sign internet security pact.

text.p: State-owned telecommunications group Telstra Corp and International Business Machines Corp's (IBM) Australian unit announced Monday they had formed an alliance to provide security for Internet-based commerce.

"The alliance plans to provide a Certification Authority service to corporate clients to help them conduct secure business with their customers, employees and partners using the Internet," Telstra and IBM said in a joint statement.
Subscribers would use their certification authentication as an electronic key to send encrypted messages and transactions using the Internet.
"'Telstra World Registry' service will enable confidentiality of communications and ensure the integrity of the data and the authentication of the sender," the groups said.
